creative_direction: Draw Zenitsu Agatsuma in a calm everyday moment, with his recognizable short yellow hair and rounded teenage face. He wears a light ocher haori whose small triangular pattern is reduced to a few visible shapes. One hand lightly holds the opposite sleeve near his chest, keeping the gesture compact and untroubled. His expression is a modest smile, with relaxed brows and both eyes open. Use hand-drawn ink lines and warm oatmeal washes, allowing slight variation in contour weight. Keep the background simple and the hair silhouette tidy, with no action pose or theatrical emotion. Give both visible irises soft violet Rinnegan rings with a clear dark pupil and bright catchlights. Keep the rings fine and contained so the gaze remains warm and readable. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
